items.title: 13.2.3 Nature of Excretory Products in relation to Habitat (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of nitrogenous wastes and habitat (PDF 6-7).

blocks.text: Kai janwaron mein osmoregulation nitrogeni fuzlaat ke ikhraj se juri hai, jo pani mein ghol kar nikale jate hain. Fuzle ki shakal is par munhasir hai ke maskan kitna pani dene deta hai.

blocks.caption: Nitrogeni fuzlaat
header: Zehreela pan aur fi gram pani
rows: Ammonia (NH3): jigar mein banti jab amino acids aur nucleic acids se hataye amino group H+ se milte hain
bohat zehreeli; fi gram taqreeban 500 mL pani
ammonotelic: zyada tar machhliyan, protozoa, sponges, coelenterates; samundari janwar seedha pani mein chhorte hain
Urea, CO(NH2)2: jigar mein ammonia se banti
kam zehreeli; fi gram taqreeban 50 mL
Uric acid, C5H4N4O3: ammonia se bohat tawanai laga kar banti; tah-nasheen (precipitate) hoti
sab se kam zehreeli aur taqreeban na-hal; fi gram taqreeban 1 mL
uricotelic: insects, registani janwar, parinde, zyada tar reptiles

blocks.text: Insaan bhi thora uric acid nikalte hain, jo gosht jaisi ghizaon ke purines tootne ka zimni nateeja hai. Khoon mein uric acid zyada ho to joron aur tissues mein crystals ban sakte hain, jis se gout naam ki dardnaak bimari hoti hai.

blocks.alt: Oopar baen: meethe pani ki machhli jis mein pani andar aata, bohat sa patla peshab nikalta aur namak active transport se liya jata hai. Oopar daen: samundari haddi wali machhli jis se pani nikalta, samundari pani piya jata, thora gaarha peshab aur chloride cells namak bahar nikalte hain. Neeche baen: ammonia, urea aur uric acid aur fi gram taqreeban 500, 50 aur 1 mL pani bars ki shakal mein. Neeche daen: zyada garmi aur thand mein insani rad-e-amal.
blocks.caption: Osmoregulation, nitrogeni fuzlaat aur insani thermoregulation (topics 13.2 aur 13.3 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Meethe pani ki machhli apne aas paas ke pani se zyada namkeen hoti hai, to pani osmosis se andar aata rehta aur namak bahar nikalta hai; yeh bohat sa patla peshab banati, namak active transport se wapas leti aur kam hi pani peeti hai. Samundari haddi wali machhli samundari pani se kam namkeen hoti hai, to pani khoti aur namak hasil karti hai; yeh samundari pani peeti, thora gaarha peshab banati aur gills ke chloride cells se namak bahar nikalti hai. Ammonia ko mehfooz taur par nikalne ke liye fi gram taqreeban 500 mL pani, urea ko 50 mL aur uric acid ko 1 mL chahiye, to pani ki kami wale janwar urea ya uric acid nikalte hain. Insani jism zyada garam ho to jild ki nalyan phailti aur paseena thanda karta hai; zyada thanda ho to nalyan sukarti, muscles kaanpte aur baal khare hote hain.

blocks.prompt: Kaunse nitrogeni fuzle ko nikalne ke liye sab se zyada pani chahiye, aur kaunsa sab se kam zehreela hai?
blocks.explanation: Ammonia ko sab se zyada pani chahiye (fi gram taqreeban 500 mL); uric acid sab se kam zehreela aur taqreeban na-hal hai. Ammonia jigar mein urea banti hai.

items: Ammonia (meetha pani), urea (zameen), uric acid (khushk maskan): kam pani, kam zehr, banane mein zyada tawanai.
